allytips: Use Rocket Grab to quickly reposition yourself or your allies in team fights.
Activate Overdrive before a fight to gain speed and attack speed advantages, but be ready for the slow effect afterward.
Power Fist can disrupt enemy positioning by lifting them up; use it to create space or set up follow-up attacks.
enemytips: Avoid staying in front of Blitzcrank during Rocket Grab's range as you'll likely get grabbed and dragged into a fight.
Try to keep your distance from Blitzcrank when he uses Overdrive, as his increased speed and attack speed can make it hard to escape.
If Static Field is active, avoid attacking Blitzcrank or be prepared for additional damage and silence.
